meta.title: Context Injection Manager
meta.description: Manages everything a new DSH session injects before its first request: system-prompt sections, runtime contexts, the skill catalog, tool schemas and workspace rules, clustered into suites (one MCP server = one switch) with per-item detail; presets, a custom prompt prefix/suffix and a token budget apply to sessions created afterwards. The plugin never edits your AGENTS.md or SKILL.md: every switch is a scoped registration and is reversible. Open it from the sidebar "Injection" icon, the composer chip, the read-only context_injection tool, or /inject.
